cc:Work.dc:title: Temporal ablation: corrected mandatory-state-preserving rerun
cc:Work.dc:description: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; 2K/H100. Success bars: saved/reported cluster-bootstrap 95% CI; no stale-use CI was reported for corrected rerun. 80/80 legacy/corrected outcome pairs and selected ID sets match. Corrected vs historical Full: +7.5 pp, 95% CI [-2.5,+17.5]; not a concurrent rerun of all variants. Sources: docs/results/ablation_2k_h100_20261111/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/ablation-2k-h100-analysis-2026-11-11.md; docs/experiments/reports/no-temporal-v104-2k-h100-2026-11-11.md
